description:
Retire the private in-process repository and executor setups of the `cli_item_validate` suite.

## Background

Shared test support constructs an initialised file-backed repository from caller-supplied configuration and an executor over a file-backed root, and builds memory stores and executors from declarations passed as data. Most tests in this target spawn `jit`, but these helpers build an in-process repository or executor of their own. The three `default_executor_with` copies are one file-backed executor setup.

Helpers to retire, from the mechanical sweep in investigation §D.6 (function names are the identity; lines at `a5aac64b1`):

- `crates/jit/tests/cli_item_validate/decision_kind_tests.rs`: `default_executor_with` (`:163`).
- `crates/jit/tests/cli_item_validate/decision_risk_story_tests.rs`: `default_executor_with` (`:119`).
- `crates/jit/tests/cli_item_validate/risk_kind_tests.rs`: `default_executor_with` (`:129`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each helper under "Helpers to retire" no longer exists, and the tests that called it obtain what it built from the shared fixtures.
- [hard] REQ-02: No file in this entry's footprint defines a function that creates an in-process repository, store or executor of its own; each obtains it from the shared constructors, and no test writes an index body or restates a value product initialisation already writes, and scenario values (for example `enforce_leases = "off"`) reach the shared constructor as declarations.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each affected test asserts what it asserted before.
title: cli_item_validate in-process tests use the shared constructors
